source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1114 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1114 was established by Ordinance No. 32814 passed by the Dallas City Council on August 14, 2024. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1114 is established on property located along the east line of Gretna Street, south of Lupo Drive. The size of PD 1114 is approximately 1.5927 acres. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article:

(1) CONTRACTOR'S MAINTENANCE YARD means a facility for the storage and maintenance of contractor's supplies and operational equipment, and related outside storage, offices, greenhouses, and storage buildings.

(2) GREENHOUSE means an enclosed structure used for the cultivation and protection of tender plants.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to the articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 1114A: development/landscape plan. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a contractor's maintenance yard, development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 1114A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the MU-1 Mixed Use District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MU-1 Mixed Use District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MU-1 Mixed Use District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MU-1 Mixed Use District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) The following additional main use is permitted:

-- Contractor's maintenance yard. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A- 4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MU-1 Mixed Use District apply.

(b) Contractor's maintenance yard.

(1) Front yard.

(A) Burgess Boulevard. Minimum front yard is 15 feet.

(B) Gretna Street. Minimum front yard is two feet.

(C) Lagoon Drive. Minimum front yard is three feet.

(2) Side and rear yard. No minimum side or rear yard.

(3) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is 0.8.

(4) Height. Except as provided in this paragraph, maximum structure height is 45 feet. Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project 12 feet above the maximum structure height.

(5) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking lots are not. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Contractor'S Maintenance Yard
Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Landscaping And Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.112. LANDSCAPING AND SCREENING.

(a) In general.

(1) Except as proved in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(2) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(b) Contractor's maintenance yard.

(1) Parking lot trees. Parking lot trees are required in accordance with Article X in the future parking area shown on the development/landscape plan.

(2) Landscape buffer.

(A) Burgess Boulevard. A 15 foot landscape buffer zone is required.

(B) Gretna Street. A 15 foot landscape buffer zone is required from the south line of the driveway shown on the development/landscape plan to the corner of Gretna Street and Burgess Boulevard.

(C) Lagoon Drive. No landscape buffer zone is required.

(D) Plant materials. The following plant materials must be located in the 15 foot landscape buffer along Burgess Boulevard and Gretna Street:

(i) Lacey Oak Trees (Quercus laceyi), being one to 12 feet tall with a two to two-and-a-half inch caliper, 30 feet apart as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(ii) 'Scarlet peaks' Yaupon Hollies (Ilex vomitoria), being five to six feet tall, spaced six feet apart as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(iii) Texas Mountain Laurels (Dermatophylun secundiflorum), being four to five feet tall, spaced six feet apart as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(iv) Pfitzer Juniper (Juniperus x Pfitzeriana), being two to three feet tall, spaced six feet apart as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(3) Right-of-way landscape areas. A landscape area comprised of groundcover/grasses and perennials must be planted and maintained between the sidewalk and property line along Gretna Street and Burgess Boulevard. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Sidewalks And Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.114. SIDEWALKS AND FENCES.

(a) Sidewalks.

(1) Except as provided in this section, sidewalks with an unobstructed width of six feet are required on all street frontages.

(2) For a contractor’s maintenance yard, no sidewalk required along Lagoon Drive.

(3) Sidewalks must be level across all driveways, curb cuts, and entrances or exits to loading areas. At the intersection of each driveway with a sidewalk, driveways must be clearly marked by colored concrete, patterned or stamped concrete, or brick pavers for pedestrian crossing.

(b) Fencing. Except along the north Property line and along Gretna Street 110 feet from the northwest corner of the Property, an eight foot fence is required along the property line. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 32814)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1114.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, all paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city. Parking areas may be compacted stone and gravel.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 32814)
